Scenarios.Name: open-load-close
Scenarios.Description: Create a screen, load its quote, display the total, close it; graph lifetime included.

Scenarios.Name: quantity-edit
Scenarios.Description: Edit quantity on an already loaded cart; one edit per operation.

Scenarios.Name: quantity-no-op
Scenarios.Description: Assign the already current quantity; one assignment per operation.

Scenarios.Name: refresh
Scenarios.Description: Reload, edit quantity twice while pending, attempt an overlapping reload, then settle.

Scenarios.Name: error-retry
Scenarios.Description: Reload and fail, edit quantity while failed, retry and succeed.

Scenarios.Name: mixed-journey
Scenarios.Description: Two loaded edits, refresh, two pending edits, overlapping reload; every tenth journey fails and retries.

Scenarios.Name: 100-cart-edit
Scenarios.Description: Edit one of 100 independently bound carts; Ranvier carts share one graph.

Scenarios.Name: close-in-flight
Scenarios.Description: Create, start loading, detach the view and dispose, then deliver a late success.

Scenarios.Name: delayed-service
Scenarios.Description: Reload with a 10 ms Task.Delay on the thread pool, then pump the simulated UI context.
